summary: Plan upgrade credit application mismatch — promotional credits visible but not deducted on invoice
description: Issue summary: Customer upgraded from Self-Serve Growth to Enterprise Reserved on 2026-03-09; expected 3 promotional credits to apply to next invoice but was invoiced full amount. Impact: customer was charged $12,000 instead of $9,000 (promo credits not applied). Environment: prod us-east tenant for Acadia Health. Timeline: 2026-03-09 14:12 UTC plan upgrade initiated via console; 14:15 API response success; 2026-03-10 invoice generated and charged. Customer states credits visible in account UI but not deducted from invoice. Request: investigate why promo credits were not applied and provide rollback or credit refund.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Log in as account admin for a self-serve account. 2) Navigate to Billing > Plan and choose Upgrade to Dedicated/Enterprise. 3) Apply promotional credits (promo code) in Billing UI under Credits. 4) Confirm upgrade; wait for billing cycle invoice generation. 5) Observe invoice lines; credits should be subtracted from total but are not.
logs: Billing service traces (tr_ids): bill-20260309-81a7 (upgrade request), invoice-20260310-7f2b (invoice generation). Console event: ui.billing.applyCredit - success. API calls: POST /v1/accounts/ACD-123/upgrade 200; POST /v1/accounts/ACD-123/credits/apply 200. Payment gateway: charge id ch_3KX... (succeeded).
comments: 2026-03-10 15:04 - Sofia Martinez: Created ticket after customer reported invoice; attaching initial invoice and screenshots.
2026-03-10 16:10 - Billing oncall (Raj Patel): Acknowledged. Asking for account id and raw invoice JSON. Requested trace ids from customer.
2026-03-11 09:20 - Customer (Acadia Health, Tara Lin): Provided account id ACD-123 and raw invoice JSON; confirmed credits show as available in console under Billing > Credits.

2026-03-11 14:55 - SRE (Liam O'Connor): Found invoice generation job used legacy discount pipeline for committed plans; suspect credits were scoped to previous billing account id and not auto-mapped during plan upgrade.
investigation_notes: - Replayed invoice generation for ACD-123 in staging; reproduced missing credit line when account had 'legacy_credit_pool' flag set. - Trace bill-20260309-81a7 shows credits apply step executed but response payload had a 200 with body {applied:0, reason:'no_matching_credit_pool'}. - Root cause hypothesis: credits created prior to 2025-11 were stored under old account namespace (legacy pool); plan upgrade flow maps to new namespace but mapping missing for legacy pool entries. - Related internal issue INT-5423 opened to add migration script to re-scope legacy credits.
resolution: Workaround: Issued manual account-level credit of $3,000 to ACD-123 on 2026-03-12 to cover missing promo application; customer invoiced amount reduced and refund processed. Permanent fix: engineering to deploy migration in billing-service to re-scope legacy credits to current account namespace; PR opened and linked. Billing will reconcile invoices for any affected accounts and apply retroactive credits. Communicated to customer and scheduled follow-up on 2026-03-18.
next_steps: 1) INT-5423: merge and run migration with dry-run and verification. 2) Billing team to run reconciliation report across accounts flagged with 'legacy_credit_pool' and auto-apply credits or issue refunds. 3) Update billing runbook to include verification of credit mappings during plan upgrades. 4) Follow-up with Acadia Health by 2026-03-18 to confirm final reconciliation.
resolution_status: Manual credit applied and refund processed; engineering migration pending
customer_communication_summary: - 2026-03-10: Acknowledged receipt and requested account info. - 2026-03-11: Informed customer we reproduced issue and are escalating to engineering. - 2026-03-12: Confirmed manual credit applied and refund processed; provided ETA for permanent fix and offered dedicated SRE call. Customer acknowledged and requested retroactive audit for prior invoices.
